::: {.dynamic .horizontal header="🕹️ Simulation Interactive : RoPE appliquée au Texte"}

::: {.controls header="Saisie et Sélection Textuelle"}
Saisissez une phrase pour générer les ancres de position, puis sélectionnez deux mots pour comparer leur encodage rotatif.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Entrée du texte par l'utilisateur
viewof sentenceInput = ui.text_area({
  value: "Le chat mange la souris dans la cuisine.",
  label: "1. Saisissez une phrase :",
  placeholder: "Tapez une phrase..."
})

// 2. Sélecteur de mots interactif (Remplace les listes déroulantes)
viewof ropeSelection = {
  const words = sentenceInput.trim().split(/\s+/);
  const container = html`<div class="org-token-stream mb-3" style="min-height: auto; padding: 10px; border-style: dashed; border-color: ${theme.base01}44;"></div>`;

  // État local pour la sélection (indices)
  let selection = [0, 1]; // Défaut : les deux premiers mots

  function render() {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    const label = html`<div class="small text-muted mb-2 italic w-100">2. Cliquez sur deux mots pour les comparer :</div>`;
    container.appendChild(label);

    words.forEach((word, i) => {
      const isA = selection[0] === i;
      const isB = selection[1] === i;
      const color = isA ? theme.blue : (isB ? theme.red : theme.base1);

      const btn = html`<span class="token-node" style="
        cursor: pointer;
        background: ${isA || isB ? color + '22' : 'transparent'};
        color: ${color};
        border: 1px solid ${isA || isB ? color + '88' : theme.base02};
        padding: 4px 10px;
        margin: 2px;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        font-weight: ${isA || isB ? 'bold' : 'normal'};
      ">${word}</span>`;

      btn.onclick = () => {
        if (selection.includes(i)) return;
        selection.shift(); // Retire le plus ancien
        selection.push(i); // Ajoute le nouveau
        render();
        container.value = { a: selection[0], b: selection[1] };
        container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
      };

      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  render();
  container.value = { a: selection[0], b: selection[1] };
  return container;
}

// Extraction des indices pour le reste de la logique
idxA = ropeSelection.a
idxB = ropeSelection.b

// 3. Découpage en tokens pour la visualisation
tokens = sentenceInput.trim().split(/\s+/).map((word, i) => ({
  id: i,
  word: word
}))

// 4. Paramètre de l'angle
viewof thetaBase = ui.slider({
  min: 5,
  max: 45,
  value: 15,
  step: 1,
  label: "3. Sensibilité (θ) :"
})
```

:::

::: {.render .transparent header="Visualisation de l'Espace Rotatif"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const canvas = ui.canvas({ width: 1000, height: 600 });
  const { node, mainNode, cx, cy, width, height } = canvas;
  const radius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.40;
  const svg = d3.select(node);
  const main = d3.select(mainNode);

  // Dessin de TOUS les tokens de la phrase (Fond)
  tokens.forEach(t => {
    const angle = t.id * thetaBase * (Math.PI / 180);
    main.append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cx + radius * Math.sin(angle))
      .attr("cy", cy - radius * Math.cos(angle))
      .attr("r", 4)
      .attr("fill", theme.base1);
  });

  // Calculs pour les deux mots sélectionnés
  const radA = (idxA * thetaBase) * (Math.PI / 180);
  const radB = (idxB * thetaBase) * (Math.PI / 180);

  const getPos = (rad, r) => ({ x: cx + r * Math.sin(rad), y: cy - r * Math.cos(rad) });
  const pA = getPos(radA, radius);
  const pB = getPos(radB, radius);

  // Arc de distance relative
  const arc = d3.arc()
    .innerRadius(radius - 20).outerRadius(radius + 5)
    .startAngle(Math.min(radA, radB))
    .endAngle(Math.max(radA, radB));

  main.append("path")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${cx}, ${cy})`)
    .attr("d", arc())
    .attr("fill", theme.orange)
    .attr("opacity", 0.15);

  // Vecteurs (Aiguilles)
  const drawVector = (p, color) => {
    main.append("line")
      .attr("x1", cx).attr("y1", cy).attr("x2", p.x).attr("y2", p.y)
      .attr("stroke", color)
      .attr("stroke-width", 4)
      .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
      .attr("stroke-dasharray", "none");
  };

  drawVector(pA, theme.blue);
  drawVector(pB, theme.red);

  // Labels textuels
  const drawLabel = (p, text, color) => {
    const labelGroup = main.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${p.x}, ${p.y - 25})`);
    const textEl = labelGroup.append("text")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("fill", theme.base00)
      .attr("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("font-weight", "800")
      .style("font-family", theme.font_code)
      .attr("font-weight", "900")
      .style("font-family", "var(--font-base)")
      .text(text);

    // Fallback measurement if getBBox fails (common in OJS)
    let bbox = textEl.node().getBBox();
    let w = bbox.width > 0 ? bbox.width : text.length * 8;
    let h = bbox.height > 0 ? bbox.height : 14;

    const px = 15;
    const py = 8;

    textEl.remove();

    labelGroup.append("rect")
      .attr("x", - (w/2 + px)).attr("y", - (h/2 + py))
      .attr("width", w + px * 2).attr("height", h + py * 2)
      .attr("rx", 10)
      .attr("fill", theme.base2)
      .attr("stroke", color)
      .attr("stroke-width", 2.5);

    labelGroup.append("text")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("dy", "0.35em")
      .attr("fill", theme.base01)
      .attr("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("font-weight", "800")
      .style("font-family", theme.font_code)
      .text(text);
  };

  drawLabel(pA, tokens[idxA].word, theme.blue);
  drawLabel(pB, tokens[idxB].word, theme.red);

  // Point central
  svg.append("circle").attr("cx", cx).attr("cy", cy).attr("r", 5).attr("fill", theme.base1);

  // 6. Légende Premium
  canvas.legend([
    { label: "Sélection A", color: theme.blue },
    { label: "Sélection B", color: theme.red },
    { label: "Déphasage", color: theme.orange }
  ]);

  return canvas.node;
}
```

:::

::: {.results header="Analyse de la Position Relative"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const dist = Math.abs(idxA - idxB);
  const totalAngle = dist * thetaBase;
  const wordA = tokens[idxA].word;
  const wordB = tokens[idxB].word;

  return html`<div class="org-matrix-grid">
    <div class="mol-stat-card" style="border-color: ${theme.blue}">
      <div class="stat-label">Mot A</div>
      <div class="stat-value" style="color: ${theme.blue}">[${idxA}]</div>
      <div class="small opacity-75">${wordA}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="mol-stat-card" style="border-color: ${theme.red}">
      <div class="stat-label">Mot B</div>
      <div class="stat-value" style="color: ${theme.red}">[${idxB}]</div>
      <div class="small opacity-75">${wordB}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="mol-stat-card" style="border-color: ${theme.yellow}">
      <div class="stat-label">Déphasage</div>
      <div class="stat-value" style="color: ${theme.yellow}">${totalAngle}°</div>
      <div class="small opacity-75">Δ = ${dist} mots</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
